messages:
morgan: Quick accessibility flag from QA: keyboard users on the dashboard can't reliably tab into the filter chips; VoiceOver reads some chips twice. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/a11y-chip.png

priya: Repro here. Tab lands on the outer toolbar then sometimes skips into a hidden button. VO says 'button' twice.

diego: Sounds like multiple tabbable nodes + wrong roles. We should treat the chips as a composite listbox with roving tabindex.

morgan: Design intent: single tab stop, arrow keys to move, visible focus with good contrast. Also counts should be announced when filters change.

priya: Proposal: container role="listbox", chips role="option" with aria-selected; only active option gets tabindex=0. Add aria-live polite region for counts.

diego: Also fix focus outline on dark theme. Current ring is too faint — needs at least 3:1 contrast. Suggest #8FD3FF or #BEE3FF depending on token palette.

morgan: For copy: visually keep "Open (3)" but add aria-label="Open, 3 results" so screen readers read clearly.

priya: I'll draft the PR with Storybook demo, Axe snapshot, and VoiceOver/NVDA manual steps. Please include acceptance steps in the PR body.

diego: I can add a small unit for roving tabindex behavior and a CSS test to verify computed outline color.

accessibility-bot: Axe scan (local): 2 violations -> predicted 0 after proposed fixes. Lighthouse accessibility bump likely. :white_check_mark:

morgan: Thanks team — tag me for UX review when ready. Short and focused fix please. :sparkles:
